findings.fix: Add, next to Bilin.reflect, `noncomputable def Bilin.projOrthogonal (g : Bilin V) (u : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V := Module.preReflection u ((g u u)⁻¹ • g.flip u)` with projOrthogonal_apply, bilin_projOrthogonal_self (hu : g u u ≠ 0), projOrthogonal_eq_self_iff, idempotence, ker = ℝ ∙ u and range = g.flip.orthogonal (ℝ ∙ u), all under hu : g u u ≠ 0. Then `Frame.spatial := Bilin.projOrthogonal g F.n`, derive the Frame lemmas from F.timelike.ne', and record `pTransverse g K = Bilin.projOrthogonal g K.q K.p` (or redefine pTransverse through it). Keep the energy-dependent lemmas (energy_div_smul_add_spatial, energy_spatial, bilin_spatial_spatial) on Frame. If the repo's one-topic rule prefers it, ship the Bilin-level projection as a prerequisite PR and rebase this one on it.
findings.issue: Frame.spatial and its lemmas spatial_apply, bilin_spatial_n, spatial_n, spatial_eq_self_iff, spatial_spatial, ker_spatial, range_spatial are stated for 0 < g n n but only use F.timelike.ne' (and n ≠ 0 derived from it). The identical projection p - (g p u / g u u) • u is already in the repo for a spacelike u as pTransverse g K (Tensors/Basic.lean:292, with pTransverse_pairing and pTransverse_orthogonal_q re-proving bilin_spatial_n under hQ2 : g K.q K.q ≠ 0), and Bilin.reflect g u (Tensors/Basic.lean:148) is the f u = 2 sibling stated at the Bilin level under hu : g u u ≠ 0. §1.2's Breit frame needs the same projection along the spacelike q axis, so the timelike special case is the wrong level.

summary: The energy, spatial-norm and angle statements are at the right level, with g.IsSymm only where the identity genuinely needs it. The spatial-projection lemmas, however, are proved only for a timelike frame vector although they use just g n n ≠ 0, and the same projection already exists in the repo for a spacelike vector (pTransverse) next to its f u = 2 sibling Bilin.reflect, so the general projection along any non-null vector should be stated once at the Bilin level and Frame.spatial derived from it.
